history.summary: A 2BR at Artra, D03 Redhill, for $2.0M / $2,413 PSF — directly atop Redhill MRT (40m, integrated development) with a slight discount to the $2,507 median and a reliable 4.97%/yr resale CAGR over 77 transactions. Premium MRT-integrated location, right-sized 2BR, liquid $2M quantum.
history.rating_rationale: Artra is integrated directly with Redhill MRT (40m) — the rarest and most rental/resale-durable attribute in this batch. PSF 2413 vs 2507 median is a modest discount, and 4.97%/yr over 77 resale txns is reliable with no new-launch bias (2021 TOP, now well into resale). A 829sqft 2BR at $2.0M sits in the deep buyer band and is the widest tenant segment. D03 Queenstown/Redhill sits in the GSW/TEL growth corridor. The high absolute PSF is the only real caution, and it is justified by the integrated location.
